blockers: At native 1x the front silhouette collapses into a narrow, symmetrical blue column. The arms, torso, coat, and legs do not create enough negative-space separation to establish a distinctive character.
The face resolves as a pale mask with a dark central interruption. Hair volume and facial planes are not stable or expressive enough at target size, producing a mannequin-like read.
The 16-frame idle strip is effectively a held pose with negligible breathing, settle, or controlled secondary motion. Celina appears frozen rather than contained and deliberate.

The locomotion grid has leg swings without convincing root compression, pelvis transfer, shoulder counter-rotation, or sword lag. The feet read as thin endpoints and several poses suggest sliding rather than planted weight.
The signature gesture is ambiguous at native 1x. Its anticipation, peak action, overshoot, and settle do not form an unmistakable Celina-specific action.
Midnight navy and obsidian surfaces merge through the lower body, while brass accents reduce to isolated specks. Glossy gradients are not consistently forming clean material planes at 1x.
The side and rear directions lose character-specific hair and facial structure, leaving a generic rounded head and rigid vertical body.
high_value_changes: Redesign the native-1x silhouette around deliberate asymmetry: give the hair a readable mass, separate the sword arm from the torso, clarify the shoulder and glove shapes, and create a stronger coat or hem contour.

Re-author the walk cycles from contact, recoil, passing, and extension keys. Keep the anchor fixed, but add visible hip transfer, shoulder counter-rotation, knee compression, planted-foot holds, and delayed sword motion.
Replace the near-static idle with a restrained but measurable breathing cycle: torso expansion, tiny head settle, controlled sword-arm adjustment, and a clear return to the exact neutral pose.
Rebuild the gesture as a readable three-part action with strong anticipation, one unmistakable rapier or collar-focused signature pose, and a disciplined overshoot-settle sequence.
Simplify the face and hair into a few high-contrast native-resolution planes. Remove the dark vertical facial void and preserve a readable head design in front, profile, and rear directions.
Lift or separate the lower-body values and reserve brass highlights for structural edges rather than isolated pixels.
optional_notes: The 117px standing height and 0px ground-anchor drift satisfy the hard technical constraints, but technical compliance does not compensate for the weak visual and animation reads.
The front-view blue, white, and brass accents provide a partial value hierarchy; this separation is not maintained reliably across the darker lower body and alternate directions.
No previous-round visual sheets were supplied, so specific regressions from earlier iterations cannot be verified.
regressions_from_previous: Previous-round comparison is unavailable; regression status is unverified.
strongest_improvements: Standing height is within the 128px limit.
Ground anchoring is technically exact with 0px measured drift.
The rapier supplies a potentially useful external diagonal and the blue-white-brass palette provides a workable starting contrast hierarchy.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Stop polishing the render and rebuild the native-1x key poses and silhouette together: establish a distinct hair-head mass, separated sword arm, stronger coat or hem contour, and a visibly transferred planted stance before deriving the full idle, locomotion, and gesture sets.
